Workplace.subject: Agricultural Extension & Marketing
Workplace.question: The _____ was Physical location where someone works.
Workplace.fact: A workplace is a location where someone works, for their employer or themselves; a place of employment. For industrialized societies, the workplace is one of the most important social spaces other than the home, constituting "a central concept for several entities: the worker and [their] family, the employing organization, the customers of the organization, and the society as a whole".
